en: A black-and-white photograph of a large steamship docked or anchored near a frozen shoreline. The ship appears to be surrounded by ice, indicating a cold or winter environment. The name 'ESCANABA' can be seen on the side of the ship, and there is a circular logo with a 'T' on the smokestack. There are no people visible on the deck, and the image gives a historical feel, consistent with early-to-mid 20th century maritime photography.
